annotations.exact_quote: Subspace clustering aims to partition the data points drawn from a union of subspaces according to their underlying subspaces.
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要开篇明确论文任务为子空间聚类，即按数据点所属潜在子空间进行划分。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a constrained low-rank representation (CLRR) for robust semisupervised subspace clustering
annotations.reason_zh: 核心方法为约束低秩表示，显式利用数据低秩表示结构进行子空间聚类，满足低秩建模定义。

annotations.exact_quote: For accurate semisupervised subspace clustering, all data that have a must-link constraint or the same label should be grouped into the same underlying subspace.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文研究半监督子空间聚类，利用must-link约束或部分相同标签指导全部数据分组，属于有限监督与未标注样本结合的学习设定。

annotations.exact_quote: CLRR explicitly incorporates supervision information as hard constraints for enhancing the discriminating power of optimal representation.
annotations.reason_zh: 半监督子空间聚类以must-link或相同标签等有限约束替代全体样本的充分实例监督，并将其作为核心硬约束，属于弱监督学习。
